Verifies an existing storm sewer network: the discharge and the fill degree of each pipe in time, for a given rain.

**Toolbox folder:** Hydro-Geomorphology<br>
**Status:** Draft<br>
**Keywords:** Sewer network, Storm water, Urban hydrology<br>
**Authors:** Daniele Andreis, Rigon Riccardo, David tamanini, Andrea Antonello, Silvia Franceschi<br>
**Class:** `org.hortonmachine.modules.TrentoPCalibration`

**Inputs**

| Parameter | Type | Unit | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `inDatabase` | file |  |  | The database of the network, with the layers network_calibration, areas and junctions and the table parameters: a GeoPackage (.gpkg) or H2GIS (.mv.db) file, or a PostGIS database, as jdbc:postgresql://host:port/database. The verified network is written into it, as the layer network_calibration_output, with the maximum discharge (qmax, l/s), its time (t_qmax, minutes) and the maximum fill degree (fillmax) of each pipe. |
| `pUser` | String |  |  | The optional user of the database. |
| `pPassword` | String |  |  | The optional password of the database. |
| `pOutPipe` | Integer | - |  | The ID of the outlet, the last pipe of the network. |
| `dt` | Integer | minutes |  | The time step of the generated rain and of the results (default: the Hydraulic time step of the parameters). With a rain file, the time step of the file is used. |
| `tMax` | Integer | minutes |  | The duration of the simulation (default: the Maximum simulation time step of the parameters, or 120). |
| `tpMaxCalibration` | Integer | minutes |  | The maximum rain duration (default: the Maximum Rain Time step of the parameters). With the rainfall curve, the rain durations from the Minimum Rain Time step up to it are tried, with a rain file only the rain up to it is used. |
| `inRain` | CSV file |  |  | The rain intensities, in mm/min, used when the rainfall curve is not in the parameters. |

**Outputs**

| Parameter | Type | Unit | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `outDischarge` | output file |  | The discharge of each pipe in time, in l/s. |
| `outFillDegree` | output file |  | The fill degree of each pipe in time. |
| `outTpMax` | Integer | minutes | The duration of the rain of the results: the one that gives the maximum discharge, when it is searched. |

**References**

- Rodríguez-Iturbe, I., Valdés, J. B. (1979). The geomorphologic structure of hydrologic response. Water Resources Research, 15(6), 1409-1420.
